description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Oathkeeper, Takeno's Daisho
uses.cardState: attached to the creature with changeling
